title: Ducted Air Conditioning quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Installation of a Daikin FDYQ140LAY 14.0kW Inverter Ducted System (indoor and outdoor units) for the Smith Residence, a single-storey, three-bedroom brick veneer home at 12 Acacia Avenue, Burleigh Heads, QLD. This includes twenty metres of R1.5 insulated 350mm flexible supply duct, sixty metres of R1.0 insulated 250mm flexible branch duct, and eight metres of R1.5 insulated 400mm flexible return air duct. Custom supply and return air box plenums will be fabricated and installed. Six 250x250mm square ceiling diffusers and one 600x400mm return air grille with filter box are included. The system will be controlled by a MyAir 5-zone system, including a MyAir tablet controller and three remote wall sensors. Twenty-five metres of insulated copper refrigerant piping (liquid and suction lines) will be run. Electrical works include a dedicated 32A circuit from the existing switchboard, using thirty metres of 6mm TPS cable, an outdoor isolator, and indoor unit connection. Ten metres of 20mm PVC drain pipe will be run to existing storm water. All necessary mounting brackets, anti-vibration pads, full system commissioning, and homeowner handover are included.
workingDetail: Ducted AC unit (indoor and outdoor), Flexible ductwork and plenums, Diffusers and return air grilles, Zone controller and motorised dampers
